hub.headline: Marathon 2 was Bungie's 1995 first-person game; its engine lives on as Aleph One.
hub.next: Point readers to Aleph One, which is maintained, and cite Bungie's original 2000 release notice once it is read.
hub.what_it_was: A portal-based software renderer for 3D levels with rooms above rooms, liquids and networked play, first on the Macintosh.
hub.what_survives: Bungie released the engine source under the GPL in January 2000. Aleph One continues it under GPL-3.0 and is maintained, with its last change on 11 October 2026.

name: Marathon 2 engine (Aleph One)
summary: Bungie's Marathon 2 engine, released under the GPL in 2000 and maintained today as Aleph One.
